gloss: infants and toddlers; babies and small children

definitions.gloss: infants and toddlers; babies and small children
definitions.explanation: A collective term for very young children, typically from birth to around age 5 or 6. Combines {乳児|にゅうじ} (infant, roughly 0-1) and {幼児|ようじ} (toddler, roughly 1-6).

examples.japanese: {乳幼児|にゅうようじ}は{入場無料|にゅうじょうむりょう}です。
examples.english: Infants and toddlers get in free.

examples.japanese: {乳幼児|にゅうようじ}を{連|つ}れての{旅行|りょこう}は{大変|たいへん}だ。
examples.english: Traveling with young children is tough.

examples.japanese: この{薬|くすり}は{乳幼児|にゅうようじ}の{手|て}の{届|とど}かない{場所|ばしょ}に{保管|ほかん}してください。
examples.english: Please keep this medicine out of reach of young children.

notes:
{乳幼児|にゅうようじ} is a compound of {乳児|にゅうじ} (nursing infant, roughly 0-1 years old) and {幼児|ようじ} (young child, roughly 1-6 years old). It is commonly used in official, medical, and public contexts.

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- {乳幼児|にゅうようじ}{健診|けんしん} (infant health checkup)
- {乳幼児|にゅうようじ}{突然死|とつぜんし}{症候群|しょうこうぐん} (sudden infant death syndrome / SIDS)
- {乳幼児|にゅうようじ}{向|む}け (for infants and toddlers)

USAGE NOTES:
This word is frequently seen on signs, product labels, and in health-related materials. It is more formal and specific than {子供|こども} or {赤|あか}ちゃん. You will encounter it at hospitals, on medicine packaging, and in public facility rules.
